name: topogra
description: Generate reproducible topographic SVG and PNG backgrounds from the command line.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/export/*.test.ts src/frame/*.test.ts src/color/*.test.ts src/studio/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx --experimental-test-coverage --test tests/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/export/*.test.ts src/frame/*.test.ts src/color/*.test.ts src/studio/*.test.ts
scripts.ci:local: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && playwright test --reporter=list && npm run test:package
scripts.check:source: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run build && npm run test:package
